key_insight: Bi-FORK learns one-to-many solution maps for symmetry-breaking bifurcations, generating multiple physically valid trajectories from a single input in high-dimensional systems.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable surrogate modeling for nonlinear engineering and physics problems where standard predictors fail due to multimodal outcomes.
method: Latent flow matching generates complete trajectories with space-time coherence.
Repulsion-guided sampling encourages distinct solution branches in one amortized pass.
Designed for high-dimensional bifurcating systems with multimodal outputs.
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, including field-valued cases with discretizations up to 260,000 points.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well repulsion-guided sampling captures all branches without missing rare modes or introducing branch artifacts.
paper_title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
